subject: English
question_text: Complete the text with suitable prepositions.
stimulus: You will be enchanted (a) ----- the beauty of tea gardens in Sylhet. Tall trees clinging (b) ---- the sides of the hills and hillocks look very delightful and charming. Then if you go to see the waterfall of Madhab Kunda (c) ----- the top of the hill, you will be amazed by the crystal clear water coming (d) ----- from a great height and crashing (e) ----- the ground below like garlands of pearls.
guide_solution: Use of prepositions: (a) with; (b) to; (c) from; (d) down; (e) on.
